symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$, here 100.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, with $h=100$.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set.
symbols.quote: A *triple* is a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$ (the letters $T$ and $S$ change meaning here).

symbols.name: second triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, used alongside $T$.
symbols.quote: A *triple* is a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$ (the letters $T$ and $S$ change meaning here).

symbols.name: triple value
symbols.meaning: The value carried by the triple $T$, which the network moves.

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.meaning: The all-one matrix, whose entries are all 1, used in the bilinear form.
symbols.quote: Over $\mathbb Q$, take the bilinear form with matrix $I-J/9$, where $J$ is the all-one matrix (the letter $J$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The space $(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ in which all labels lie.
symbols.quote: The label space is $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, built from the [Tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md), with dimension $D=h^3$ (the letter $D$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension $h^3$ of the label space.
symbols.quote: The label space is $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, built from the [Tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md), with dimension $D=h^3$ (the letter $D$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A nondegenerate subspace of the label space carried by a vertex (the letter $U$ changes meaning here).
symbols.quote: A label is a nondegenerate subspace $U\subseteq\mathcal F$, and $P_U$ denotes the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ (the letters $U$ and $P$ change meaning here, $P_U$ being the label projection used on later pages).

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto a label $U$ along its orthogonal complement.
symbols.quote: A label is a nondegenerate subspace $U\subseteq\mathcal F$, and $P_U$ denotes the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ (the letters $U$ and $P$ change meaning here, $P_U$ being the label projection used on later pages).

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: The label on an edge that contains the smaller label $U$.
symbols.quote: On an edge with labels $U\subseteq U'$, the smaller label $U$ lying inside the larger $U'$, the difference $P_{U'}-P_U$ is the identity on $U'\cap U^\perp$ and zero on $U\oplus U'^\perp$.

symbols.name: source count
symbols.meaning: The number of sources, one for each triple of triples.
symbols.quote: Each of the $N=\binom h3^3$ sources (the letter $N$ changes meaning here) is indexed by a triple of triples $(T_1,T_2,T_3)$, has the line through $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$ as label, and carries $-P_U$.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, which is the sum of the edge ranks.
symbols.quote: Summing over all edges gives $s$, the total number of smaller calls (the letter $s$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be the total dimension lost on decreasing edges, where a label shrinks (the letter $L$ changes meaning here).

relations.quote: It is built inside a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md).
